reviews.comment: Good professor and easy grader, but I am not a fan of the flipped class model. If you fall behind even a bit, its gonna be a tough race. Coding homework was not bad and exams where split into 80% in class 20% group take home coding assignment. If you are good with not procrastinating and watching the monotone lecture videos, an A should be easy
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Class was on zoom and also recorded. Exams are similar to the homeworks and quizzes.

Amazing guy. Everything is easy and exams are open everything. He does not curve or round which sucks but it's alright. No attendance but people stopped coming to class so he decided to have pop quizzes, which was weird since he said it was a flipped class style. But overall very easy class.

Good professor just boring material. Flipped classroom style so prepare to watch 2-3 hours' worth of videos each week accompanied by quizzes. Videos are boring and monotone. Weekly homeworks are pretty easy. 2 exams, they are 80% in class and 20% take home. Take home portion is a hard engineering problem - find a good group.

Dr. Wu is good at teaching, the class is flipped classroom style so keeping up with weekly videos and quizzes was a pain. But, I am terrible at coding and I got a B in this class pretty easily; the in class portion of the exam is 80% and take home is 20% for each test. Beware of pop quizzes throughout the semester also

Wu is great. Tests are rather easy even though it is coding, there's an in class and a take home part. In class test is very straightforward, I'm not good at coding and got an A. Take home is harder but he grades it easy. What will determine your grade is keeping up with the four or five quizzes a week and hours of videos to understand the material
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Wu taught flipped classroom style, so class attendance was low (but he did not mind). He provided all the materials needed to do well on exams. His exams were open notes, "open Google", but it is important to understand concepts and have prepared codes prior to the exam. I appreciate how organized and helpful Dr. Wu was. He's a great choice!

Dr. Wu has been one of the most fair, clear and painless professors I've had. Coming from little coding background, his notes and recorded lectures made the curriculum very doable, with little confusion. He's very open to answer questions on homework, exams and I'd recommend him to anyone in ChemE

The most boring lectures I have ever sat through. He also speaks directly into the microphone so its one of the loudest lectures I've ever sat through. The textbook has MANY typos throughout. It was so hard to pay attention to lectures, and even then it wasn't always helpful. Honestly, it was a frustrating course with him as my professor.

Wu must be chinese for goat. Super chill class and atmosphere, extremely helpful in office hours and the least stressful CHEN class i've ever taken. He takes attendance which kinda sucks but other than that he's a dawg.
